cv.name: Stefan Kollmann
cv.headline: Program Manager | Automotive & E-Mobility Programs | Engineering-to-Launch
cv.summary: Program manager with seven years in automotive engineering in Styria, with moves between supplier, OEM contracting, a short start-up stint and back to the supplier side. Coordinates cross-functional vehicle and component programs through SOP.

experience.title: Program Manager
bullets: Run an e-axle program for a European OEM from B-sample to SOP with a team of 35
Manage program budget, timing and risks through the APQP gates
Weekly steering with the customer's purchasing and engineering teams
Brought the PPAP back on track after a three-month delay at a casting supplier

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Coordinated the prototype build of a charging robot; the company stopped operations after 10 months

experience.title: Project Engineer (contractor)
bullets: Coordinated test vehicle builds and change requests on assignment at a vehicle manufacturer

experience.title: Test Engineer
bullets: Planned and evaluated durability tests on gearbox test benches

education.degree: Dipl.-Ing. (MSc) Mechanical Engineering and Business Economics
